comment: GLB assets generated via Higgsfield AI (image_to_3d). Names map to AssetLibrary keys; `fit` rescales the GLB's bounding box to the gameplay size [w,h,l] in metres; `yaw` rotates the nose to face +Z. Delete an entry to fall back to the procedural mesh. ped-civilian-rigged.glb is bundled (auto-rigged skeleton) for the skinned-character upgrade — see ASSETS.md.
